provenance_contract.note: Authored route and usability copy organizes the supplied Beta Earth class inventory without claiming that the source documents specified these exact onboarding labels or recommendations.

difficulty_scale.beginner: A clear role, forgiving recommendation, and low setup burden.
difficulty_scale.moderate: A focused role with one meaningful positioning or resource tradeoff.
difficulty_scale.advanced: A hybrid or high-commitment role that asks the player to read encounters and coordinate several tools.

classes.name: Chosen One
classes.summary: A relentless front-line combatant built to keep pressure on a target and recover through adversity.
classes.tradeoff: Stronger at sustained personal pressure than at controlling several enemies or directly supporting allies.
classes.technique_summary: Convert adversity into a controlled burst of regeneration.
classes.passive_summary: Sustained danger sharpens your offense while your body recovers.
classes.exploration_summary: Recognize traces of meteor-source energy before others do.

ability_branches.name: Blooded Renewal
ability_branches.summary: Turn recent harm into a stronger controlled recovery pulse.

passive.name: Adversity Rhythm
passive.summary: Every specialization action restores a small amount of health.

follow_up.name: Second Pulse
follow_up.summary: A smaller recovery follows before the body loses the rhythm.

upgrade_options.name: Ascendant Force
upgrade_options.summary: Deepen Blooded Renewal with stronger primary and follow-up effects at the cost of greater commitment.

upgrade_options.name: Unbroken Cycle
upgrade_options.summary: Refine Blooded Renewal for faster recovery, lighter commitment, and a longer follow-up window.

ability_branches.counterplay: Regeneration is bounded and cannot erase concentrated incoming damage. The action creates 2 sec of recovery, and the follow-up closes after 12 sec.

passive.summary: Every specialization action builds a small guard reserve.

follow_up.name: Rally Reserve
follow_up.summary: Draw a final health-and-guard pulse from the temporary station.

upgrade_options.name: Command Authority
upgrade_options.summary: Deepen Command Aid Station with stronger primary and follow-up effects at the cost of greater commitment.

upgrade_options.name: Formation Discipline
upgrade_options.summary: Refine Command Aid Station for faster recovery, lighter commitment, and a longer follow-up window.

ability_branches.counterplay: The reserve is temporary battlefield help, not immunity. The action creates 2 sec of recovery, and the follow-up closes after 12 sec.
